tables.label: TABLE 1
tables.caption: Sequences, retention times, HPLC purities, and mass spectrometry data of the synthesized peptides.
footnotes: Note: Red for Cathepsin derived sequences and Blue for cecropin derived sequences.
Percentage determined by HPLC at 220 nm after purification by column chromatography.

tables.label: TABLE 2
tables.caption: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of hybrid peptides against selected microorganisms.

tables.label: TABLE 3
tables.caption: Representation of the grid box centers in x, y, and z coordinates, referring to the five prospected binding sites for each of the target proteins. PDB ID (Identification code in the Protein Database): 1AOB (Thymidylate synthase), 1EI1 (DNA gyrase B), 1YR3 (Xanthosine phosphorylase), 1USQ (Dr hemagglutinin), 1WEI (A/G‐specific DNA glycosylase), and 1A99 (Periplasmic putrescine‐binding protein).

tables.label: TABLE 4
tables.caption: Docking results by AutoDock Vina. Peptides were used as ligands, and targets obtained by PharmMapper were used as receptors. PM Rank (Overall rank by PharmMapper), PDB ID (Protein Data Bank identification code).

tables.label: TABLE 5
tables.caption: Donor (electron donating residue), Acceptor (electron acceptor residue), D‐A distance (distance between heavy atoms of acceptor and electron donor), GLY 1.L N (residue name/number/chain ID/shared electron atom), L (Ligand ID), and Rx (Receptor Subunit Identification).
